target_text:
If someone old or your older sibling is sharing wisdom with you stop what your doing and listen, because most of the time the person, he or she, is trying to tell you whats going to happen if you hit a certain age. Its important to know something new, and because they experienced it they will know what to expect.

Sharing wisdom is a lot of knowledge thrown at your face. It's more than "just talk". Sharing wisdom helps the person by letting he or she know not to do this or to go for it. It also helps you out because you get to share that wisdom and let your little brother or sister or your son if you have one. The moment you have will not stay forever, but not unless you share.

for a few months i had my mother and sisters to tell me whats right from wrong. But not every parent shares with there kid or even talks to them. Almost every child is dropping out of school or joining a gang which is not good for them. every single child and parent on this earth must talk and give there children some experience about whats good for them.

The experience of you and your child will be fun like a roller coster its and fun and then gets really serious. because messing around is not how to tell a kid to do something right you have to sit down and be serious about how everything might change around or getting a job. its a wonderful experience and i think every kid should get a chance to learn something new and share there own wisdom.
